title: Merida and the bear.
lines: In the mountains of Scotland there's a castle.
She has wild red hair with lots and lots of curls.
She rides her horse Angus through the forest.
He has only one leg, because a bear took the other one.
Merida also has three little brothers.
They're very naughty and they're always stealing cakes.
Mum wants Merida to be a proper princess.
Don't laugh with your mouth open.
And Mum wants Merida to get married.
Three princes come to the castle.
But Merida doesn't want to get married.
She picks up her own bow and arrow.
I'll shoot for my own hand!
She hits the target three times.
In the forest Merida sees little blue lights.
She follows the lights to a little hut.
The witch gives her a little cake.
Merida and Mum-bear escape to the forest.
Merida teaches Mum to fish in the river.
Mum teaches Merida to be patient.
For the first time in a very long time.
The witch has left a note.
To break the spell, you must mend what is broken.
In her anger she cut the family tapestry.
But what's really broken is her bond with Mum.
The three little brothers had turned into bear cubs too.
From now on Merida and Mum listen to each other.
And together they ride horses through the forest.
